title: Luxe Resort | Heated Pool+Spa | 5 Bedrooms
description:
"This place is a mansion with beautiful views and an exceptional backyard. You will not be disappointed." - Brittany, '23

Searching for an experience beyond the ordinary? 
Welcome to Desert Dreamscape! A luxurious, resort-inspired home - the perfect choice for that guys’ golf trip or girls’ weekend, or for couples and families who are looking for a place to relax, unwind and enjoy the iconic Scottsdale area.

 The space 
“This property is a great setup for large groups. The outside areas allowed for many options from sitting around the fire-pits, lounging around the pool, or dining al fresco… You really nailed the seating options inside and out. And, the landscaping was gorgeous.” – Spencer

• 5 bedrooms; 3 King Beds, 3 Queen Beds, 1 queen size sofa bed 
• 4.5 clean spacious bathrooms 
• Fully stocked kitchen 
• Double dining tables!

• Gym including a Peloton Bike, Lulu Lemon Studio Mirror, and free weights. 
• High-speed wifi 
• Lots of games and entertainment including a pool table, board games, wall games etc! 
• 7 Smart TVs

My family and I are local, and we already knew how special, and convenient, this area is. But seeing the resort-like grounds of this incredible estate were what totally hooked us!

The Dreamscape experience begins right as you enter the grand Spanish-style courtyard entrance to this 1.25 acre property and open the door to your personal entertainment complex!

A classic pool table complements a spacious living room / game lounge area, which then opens out to the main living room with another huge smart TV - perfect for board games or watching the WM Open highlights! Yet another more intimate seating area, just adjacent, features a custom Infinity Table stocked with hundreds of digital games.

Downstairs:

• Pool table lounge 
• Dining area with 2 large tables 
• Kitchen 
• TV / fireplace lounge 
• Wester-themed master en-suite 
• Hallway bathroom by the entrance, second full bath w/pool access behind the kitchen

"We couldn’t believe the amount of games Nathan had there, the kids lost their minds and the adults played hours of pool on this beautiful table." - Dennis, '23

Just off this massive living / entertainment space is the first western-themed master suite with its own private sitting area and full bath. There’s also a separate powder room tucked under the stairs. This newly renovated home offers the perfect combination of sophistication, convenience, and comfort at every corner.

Continue to indulge in the professionally decorated surroundings of this luxurious home by stepping into the expansive dining room, which really does have seating for 20 - all overlooking the landscaped yard and pool, and the magnificent McDowell Mountain Range beyond, through stunning Spanish-style picture windows.

"This place is a MANSION - with beautiful views and an exceptional backyard.” – Brittany, ‘23

We’ve made every effort to think of “everything” here, and no dining experience is complete without a fully stocked gourmet kitchen to create in!

There’s every kind of gadget and a brand new suite of appliances including a Sub Zero refrigerator and a DaCor oven, and cozy island seating with its own view out to the pool! 

The kitchen functions as a hub for all the outdoor entertaining as well. Step outside with a cup of coffee and immediately relax into a shaded sectional and pool view. Or serve an al fresco meal at the outdoor dining table. 

Grill at the ultimate Pool Bar with your choice: classic gas grill, with oversized burner, or Green Egg, and blend your favorite margaritas while you enjoy the misters! There’s even a designated full bath with shower directly off the Bar area!

“Tons of space!!!...My kids did not bother me ONE time saying they were bored.” – Brittany, ‘23

“This backyard is like your own resort” – Suzy

The Pool is a true oasis, with a ledge seating area, waterfall, diving board, hot tub, and plenty of additional seating and umbrellas. 

But what puts this property in a league of its own is the designated cornhole and croquet turf yard and the separate putting green, each with their very own firepit lounge areas! No one will ever miss enjoying one of our famous Arizona sunsets here! Watch the colors, described as “magical”, changing from brilliant shades of pink, purple, and orange as they cross the sky. 

Then, as night falls, the desert sky fills with stars while you roast s'mores or sip a bourbon.

• 2 outdoor fire pits with seating! One off the fireplace lounge, the other by the putting green. 
• Covered outdoor dining area and sofa seating area. 
• Outdoor kitchen with a bar and 2 grills. 
• Pool & hot tub w/ optional pool fencing for added safety. 
• Large yard game greenery. 
• Putting green. 
• Free Parking: RV Gate, 3 Car- Garage + Street + Driveway.

“Photos cannot justify how beautiful this place is.” - Jason

Upstairs the luxury continues. There’s a dedicated in-home Gym with a Peloton and a Lululemon Sports Mirror.

There are also two charming Queen bedrooms, complete with Arizona-inspired themes, and a quintessential Route 66/Barrett Jackson Bunk Room - all which share a full bath down the hall. Just a note, each newly remodeled and well-appointed bathroom is fully stocked with fresh towels, shampoo, conditioner, body wash, and hair dryers.

And the other expansive Master Suite is here as well, with a stunning spa tub Master Bath and private balcony that both look out onto the landscaped pool and the mountains.

This is the perfect retreat after a day exploring all that Scottsdale has to offer! We can’t wait to host you here at Desert Dreamscape!

Upstairs:

• Primary Golf-themed Suite: King bed, en-suite bathroom 
• The Sunset Room: King bed, shared full bathroom 
• Wild Horses Room: Queen bed, shared full bathroom 
• Barrett Jackson Room: Queen over queen bunk beds, shared full bathroom 
• Gym including a Peloton Bike, Lulu Lemon Studio Mirror, and free weights
• Full bathroom

THE AREA:

"Location was fantastic, central to Scottsdale for shopping and recreation, with great hikes just minutes away." – Spencer

Westworld of Scottsdale (8 miles, 14 minutes) 
• Nationally recognized equestrian and special event facility. Annually hosts the Scottsdale Arabian Horse Show, Barrett-Jackson Class Car Show Auction, and Junk in the Trunk Vintage Market.

OdySea Aquarium - 14 minutes 
• The Southwest’s largest aquarium- sharks, penguins, sea turtles, exotic fish, and more!

TPC Scottsdale Stadium Golf Course - 16 minutes 
• Golf Course that annually hosts the famous Waste Management Phoenix Open!

Old Town Scottsdale - 18 minutes
• Famed boutique shops, galleries, best restaurants/bars/nightlife, and cultural attractions.

The Scottsdale Quarter, Kierland Commons, Fountain Hills – 18 minutes 
• Shopping, dining, and much more! We love Capital Grille, Mastros, or El Encanto!

Desert Botanical Gardens - 23 minutes 
• Explore the gardens, with five-themed trails including Desert Wildflowers and Desert Living.

Phoenix Sky Harbor Airport - 25 minutes 
• International Airport. Largest airport in Arizona.

Phoenix Zoo - 26 minutes
• Family fun! Home to more than 3,000 animals.

Camelback Mountain, Pinnacle Peak Park - 30 minutes 
• Tons of Hiking Trails

Pinnacle Peak Park - 31 minutes 
• Hiking Trails

PLUS:
• Talking Stick Casino - 14 minutes
• Salt River Wild Horses - 15 minutes 
• Spring training baseball - 15 minutes 
• Desert Botanical Gardens - 23 minutes 
• Junk in the Trunk Vintage Market

City of Scottsdale STR License number: 2036870

 Guest access 
As a guest, you will have access to the entire house, and all the upscale amenities. This includes exclusive use of the pool, hot tub, large uncovered and covered patio, (2) fire pits , essential toiletries, free wifi, multiple Smart TVs, and free parking.

 Other things to note 
CONCIERGE SERVICES:

Available upon request for additional fees. Our concierge services are available for golf tee times, a private chef, top restaurant reservations, a sushi night, bike rentals, stocked pool drinks and more!

“Nathan made the week awesome! He planned every detail for us - restaurants, golf, hiking, groceries and more!” – Jennifer

**Heating of the pool and/or hot tub is an additional charge. Please contact Nathan for your trip's special rate.

Please inquire about our special incentive rates for summer and pre-season bookings.
Don't hesitate to reach out with any questions, we are here to make your stay extraordinary! Parties and events require written consent from the host. If you desire to have a party or event please inquire! special pricing may apply. Absolutely no smoking.
